questionnaire_2026.Why I'm standing: I am sick of seeing money wasted on bureaucracy that is bloated and endless consultants. I want to see New Zealand move toward a direct democracy, where people get the say and governments' jobs are to carry out the will of the people. I also in the first instance will be looking for accountability on decisions made by government & using Parliamentary privilege to call out lies where I see them.
questionnaire_2026.About me: I fight the good fight everyday calling out MPs for their dishonesty with the public. Via OIAs I have done a lot to reveal mistruths particularly around the covid response. I am also here supporting Sue Grey for West Coast-Tasman having lived here for 34 years.
